items.title: Harold Christophe Interview, 1961-08-01
items.q: We had a fella by the name of Baptiste, he's in that playing, well Dave was with us, with the St. John Band.

ctx.x: Did you have about the same lineup as they have now in the brass band? Like two, three saxes? What was the lineup?

Well, you had the sax, drum, trombone, bass. Now at that time when we had the St. John Band, now that was before Richardson went with the URIC. We had Richardson with us. Oh yeah. We had a fella by the name of Baptiste, he's in that playing, well Dave was with us, with the St. John Band.

items.title: Crescent City Crystals: Dave Bailey, Harold Christophe, Albert Delone, Sylvester Handy Interview, 1963-11-13

ctx.x: The End The End The End

We're ready. Yeah, I've had a calm moment. Yeah, okay, fine. We're ready to start now. Let me think, can you... Harold Kristoff, yeah, Harold Kristoff. Can you tell me your date of birth, Harold? I was born 1912, 4th of July. 4th of July, 1912, right? Any of your family play instruments? Well, my grandfather, he played guitar. My father played guitar. What were their names? My father was... My grandfather was Louis Kristoff. He was from San Fernando. And my dad was Louis Kristoff, Jr. Were you born in New Orleans?
Born in New Orleans and the Trimmy.
